an3.93:1.1: tīṇīmāni bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā pavivekāni paññāpenti
an3.93:2.1: tatrīdaṃ bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā cīvarapavivekasmiṃ paññāpenti sāṇānipi dhārenti masāṇānipi dhārenti chavadussānipi dhārenti paṃsukūlānipi dhārenti tirīṭakānipi dhārenti ajinānipi dhārenti ajinakkhipampi dhārenti kusacīrampi dhārenti vākacīrampi dhārenti phalakacīrampi dhārenti kesakambalampi dhārenti vālakambalampi dhārenti ulūkapakkhampi dhārenti
an3.93:2.2: idaṃ kho bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā cīvarapavivekasmiṃ paññāpenti.
an3.93:3.1: tatrīdaṃ bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā piṇḍapātapavivekasmiṃ paññāpenti
an3.93:3.2: sākabhakkhāpi honti sāmākabhakkhāpi honti nivārabhakkhāpi honti daddulabhakkhāpi honti haṭabhakkhāpi honti kaṇabhakkhāpi honti ācāmabhakkhāpi honti piññākabhakkhāpi honti tiṇabhakkhāpi honti gomayabhakkhāpi honti vanamūlaphalāhārā yāpenti pavattaphalabhojī
an3.93:3.3: idaṃ kho bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā piṇḍapātapavivekasmiṃ paññāpenti.
an3.93:4.1: tatrīdaṃ bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā senāsanapavivekasmiṃ paññāpenti araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ bhusāgāraṃ
an3.93:4.2: idaṃ kho bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā senāsanapavivekasmiṃ paññāpenti.
an3.93:4.3: imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi aññatitthiyā paribbājakā pavivekāni paññāpenti.
an3.93:5.1: tīṇi kho panimāni bhikkhave imasmiṃ dhammavinaye bhikkhuno pavivekāni
an3.93:5.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā ca hoti dussīlañcassa pahīnaṃ hoti tena ca vivitto hoti
an3.93:5.4: sammādiṭṭhiko ca hoti micchādiṭṭhi cassa pahīnā hoti tāya ca vivitto hoti
an3.93:5.5: khīṇāsavo ca hoti āsavā cassa pahīnā honti tehi ca vivitto hoti.
an3.93:5.6: yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā hoti dussīlañcassa pahīnaṃ hoti tena ca vivitto hoti
an3.93:5.7: sammādiṭṭhiko ca hoti micchādiṭṭhi cassa pahīnā hoti tāya ca vivitto hoti
an3.93:5.8: khīṇāsavo ca hoti āsavā cassa pahīnā honti tehi ca vivitto hoti
an3.93:5.9: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu aggappatto sārappatto suddho sāre patiṭṭhito.
an3.93:6.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave kassakassa gahapatikassa sampannaṃ sālikhettaṃ
an3.93:6.8: sīghasīghaṃ palālāni uddharāpetvā sīghasīghaṃ bhusikaṃ uddharāpeyya
an3.93:6.13: evamassu tassa bhikkhave kassakassa gahapatissa tāni dhaññāni aggappattāni sārappattāni suddhāni sāre patiṭṭhitāni
an3.93:7.1: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā ca hoti dussīlañcassa pahīnaṃ hoti tena ca vivitto hoti
an3.93:7.2: sammādiṭṭhiko ca hoti micchādiṭṭhi cassa pahīnā hoti tāya ca vivitto hoti
an3.93:7.3: khīṇāsavo ca hoti āsavā cassa pahīnā honti tehi ca vivitto hoti
an3.93:7.4: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu aggappatto sārappatto suddho sāre patiṭṭhitoti. 95
